clean.label: Clean, no style
clean.note: Everything in the catalog that fits your restrictions.

paleo.label: Paleo
paleo.note: No grains, legumes, dairy or soy.

keto.label: Keto
keto.note: Very low carb: about 20 g of carbs or less per dinner. No grains, legumes, starchy vegetables or most fruit.

animal.label: Animal-based
animal.note: Meat, fish, eggs and dairy with fruit and a few gentle plants. No grains, legumes or most vegetables.

whole30.label: Whole30
whole30.note: No grains, legumes, dairy, soy or added sugar. Our catalog has no added sugar.

slowcarb.label: Slow-Carb
slowcarb.note: No "white" carbs, fruit or dairy. Beans, meat and vegetables instead.
